description: Chapters 3-4: rebuild the level-34 living room and balcony with real architecture (oak plank floor, walnut skirting, ceiling cove with hidden LED, recessed downlights, slim bronze glazing frames and sliding door, door frame, kitchen run) and a procedural furniture library (modular sofa with sagging cushions, leather lounge chair, marble coffee table, travertine side table, wool rug, arc floor lamp, pendants, media console, framed artwork, books, ceramic vases, potted plants with procedural leaves, walnut dining table with 6 instanced chairs, marble-topped kitchen island with 3 stools, sheer curtains; balcony loungers, low table, grass planters, frameless glass balustrade with bronze cap rail). Fixes review finding F1 (the stray cream plane is the floor-lamp shade box at local (0.9,1.55,1.75) directly in front of the ch3 camera) and enforces a camera keep-out corridor by unit test. Tunes ch3/ch4 camera targets so the river (F2) is framed. Depends on FEAT-001; independent of FEAT-002 except shared index.js/camera-rig.js. Detail and layout table: plan.md '3D realism upgrade' item 3.
steps: Extend the furniture library FEAT-002 created (reuse modularSofa, rug, vase, plantedTree as-is; add the rest): C:\Users\dusitm\Desktop\Test-Kiro\tessera-sathorn\src\scene\furniture\seating.js (modularSofa, loungeChair, diningChairGeometry, barStoolGeometry, outdoorLounger), tables.js (marbleCoffeeTable, sideTable, diningTable, kitchenIsland, outdoorLowTable), lighting.js (floorLamp, pendant, linearPendant - emissive shades use mats.ledStrip-like MeshBasic toneMapped false), decor.js (rug, books InstancedMesh, vase x3 profiles, artFrame with abstract tessera DataTexture canvas - no text, plant with ~120 seeded instanced curved leaves, sheerCurtain, mediaConsole). Each returns a Group batched with geometry-kit Batcher, base at y=0, tagged userData.furniture=true (wall/ceiling items also userData.mount='wall'|'ceiling'), with a contact-shadow decal for floor items. No document usage. Seeded randomness only.

Rebuild C:\Users\dusitm\Desktop\Test-Kiro\tessera-sathorn\src\scene\sets\residence.js keeping RESIDENCE_ORIGIN, room bounds, H=3.1, glazing x -3.75, door opening z -0.5..1.7 and 2.4 m balcony. Implement the architecture bullets and place furniture per the layout table in plan item 3 (sofa along south wall facing north, coffee table on rug, armchair, floor lamp SW corner, art on south wall, media console, dining for six by the north window with linear pendant, kitchen run on north wall + island with 3 stools and 2 pendants, 2 plants, sheers stacked at glazing ends). Delete the old warmLight lamp-shade box (F1). Exactly 3 PointLights, no point-light shadows.

Balcony in residence.js: travertine deck 600 mm tiles, slab edge with drip line, soffit with 4 downlights, fluted concrete side fins, 5 frameless low-iron physical-glass panels (envDusk) on bronze shoe + standoffs with a 50 mm round bronze cap rail (tube) at 1.1 m, 2 outdoor loungers at (-4.6,0,-2.1) and (-5.4,0,-2.1) facing west, low table, 2 concrete trough planters with instanced grass blades at z 2.4..2.9.

C:\Users\dusitm\Desktop\Test-Kiro\tessera-sathorn\src\scene\camera-rig.js: ch3 target -> R(-6, 1.15, -0.2); ch4 target -> R(-60, -11, -4); do not move ch1/ch2 keys or the ch3/ch4 positions; adjust path23 midpoints only if the keep-out test fails.

Add C:\Users\dusitm\Desktop\Test-Kiro\tessera-sathorn\tests\unit\residence-layout.test.js: build createResidence(createMaterials()) and createCameraRig(RESIDENCE_ORIGIN); updateMatrixWorld; for each userData.furniture group compute Box3.setFromObject; assert (a) no furniture box within 1.2 m of the ch3/ch4 keyframe positions, (b) for poseAt(p), p = 2..3 step 0.05, no furniture box with max.y > 0.9 (local) within 0.6 m XZ of the camera, (c) floor items have min.y within +/-0.02 of 0 and wall/ceiling-mounted items touch their plane within 0.03 m (no floating objects).

Regenerate screenshots (run shots); open screenshots\desktop-1440\chapter-03-living-room.png, screenshots\desktop-1920\chapter-03-living-room.png, screenshots\desktop-1440\chapter-04-balcony.png and the -reduced variants. Confirm no floating cream plane, furniture reads with materials, and the river shows as a lighter reflective band beyond low blocks (needs verification during implementation: if not legible, raise river envMapIntensity or lower the skyline wedge cap; keep sky colours). Record ch3/ch4 draw calls in findings.
acceptance_criteria: build passes; scene chunk within 680 kB / 175 kB gzip
Chapter 3 screenshot at 1920 has no floating cream rectangle; sofa, coffee table, dining set and kitchen island are recognisable
Chapter 4 screenshot at 1440 shows the river as a visible band to the west (or the finding is recorded as needing follow-up with what was tried)
Chapters 3 and 4 each render with <= 250 draw calls
verification: Open regenerated chapter-03/04 PNGs under C:\Users\dusitm\Desktop\Test-Kiro\tessera-sathorn\screenshots and inspect them
findings: SIZES: build OK, dist\assets\scene-*.js 645.90 kB raw / 170.90 kB gzip (FEAT-002 624.5/163.6; budget 680/175, so only ~4 kB gzip headroom is left for FEAT-004). TESTS: unit 8 files / 71 tests pass (66 + residence-layout 5). E2E: 42/42 pass in 6.9 min. An earlier full run had one desktop-1920 screenshot test time out waiting for data-scene-ready (20 s). That run overlapped a second Playwright process I had started by mistake. The clean rerun passed, but start-up under 2 parallel SwiftShader workers is the tightest margin, so FEAT-004 should not add start-up work. Screenshots were regenerated by the run. DRAW CALLS (window.__tessera.renderInfo(), desktop-1440, SwiftShader, shadow pass included; measured with a temporary spec that was deleted afterwards): ch1 124 / 307k tris, ch2 121 / 293k, ch3 159 / 226k, ch4 83 / 155k (budget 250). data-scene-ready 8.0 s single worker (FEAT-002: 8.8 s). The residence is hidden at chapter 1, so its shaders compile on the lift swap, not at start-up. F1 FIXED: the warmLight lamp-shade box is gone. The new arc floor lamp stands in the SW corner (-3.2, 0, 2.7) with its lit linen shade at (-2.49, 1.68..1.9, 2.23), outside the camera corridor. The chapter 3 shots at 1440/1920 (normal and -reduced) show no cream rectangle. KEEP-OUT TEST (tests\unit\residence-layout.test.js): (a) every furniture mesh group (its own meshes, with nested styling objects checked on their own) is >= 1.2 m from the ch3/ch4 keyframe positions; (b) nothing with local max.y > 0.9 is within 0.6 m XZ of poseAt(2..3 step 0.05); (c) floor pieces have min.y within 0.02 of 0, styling objects sit within 0.02 of their host's userData.top, ceiling pieces reach y 3.1 within 0.03, and the art frame touches the south wall plane. Also asserts the expected pieces exist and exactly 3 PointLights with no shadows. path23 midpoints did not need changing. CAMERA: ch3 target R(-6,1.15,-0.2) and ch4 target R(-60,-11,-4); positions, ch1/ch2 and path23 are unchanged. RIVER (F2): legible at 1440 ch4 (normal and -reduced). The water reads as a lighter, sun-glinted band beyond the low wedge blocks, with promenade lights along the bank, so no envMapIntensity or wedge-cap change was needed. NEW API: furniture/util.js adds derived(mats,key,make) (per-palette cached derived materials: teak, shadeLinen, bookCloth, sheer), taperedLeg(top,bottom,h), instancedSet(name, parts, items, mats, {decal}) (one InstancedMesh per part plus an instanced decal), and an assemble(..., {extra}) option. seating.js: loungeChair, diningChairGeometry, barStoolGeometry (both return [{geometry, material}] for instancing), outdoorLounger, teakMaterial. tables.js: sideTable, marbleCoffeeTable (extruded rounded rectangle, 40 mm bevel, marble plinth), diningTable (grain along length, aprons, tapered legs), kitchenIsland (marble waterfall top, walnut base, 0.3 m knee overhang on +z), outdoorLowTable. lighting.js: floorLamp, pendant, linearPendant (ceiling-mounted, origin on the ceiling plane). decor.js: books (InstancedMesh, cloth colours), artFrame (seeded DataTexture of three tessera blocks, no text, mount 'wall'), plant (lathe pot plus seeded instanced fiddle-leaf blades; minX keeps tips off the glass), sheerCurtain (mount 'ceiling', 55% opacity, DoubleSide, no shadows), mediaConsole (reeded doors, brass pulls), grassPlanter (concrete trough, instanced blades). Hosts expose userData.top for styling objects. residence.js exports ROOM {H, glassX, eastX, northZ, southZ, door, edgeX}. ARCHITECTURE: oak planks run east-west at the real 180 mm (repeated textures on a cloned oak material), walnut skirting, 300 mm perimeter cove on N/S/E with a hidden LED strip and a washed slot soffit, 6 interior and 4 balcony instanced downlights with bezels, bronze 50x120 extruded mullions plus head/sill, a sliding leaf parked on its own track, a south door with walnut casing and a brass lever, a kitchen run (ink plinth, 4 walnut fronts with shadow gaps, marble counter and backsplash, sink, smoked-glass hob, brass tap, tall walnut units with brass pulls), 600 mm travertine deck tiles, slab edge and soffit with drip lines, fluted concrete side fins, a bronze shoe with 5 low-iron panels and standoffs, and a 50 mm bronze tube cap rail at 1.1 m. 3 PointLights: lamp glow 2.5, dining 3.5, fill 8, decay 2. DEVIATIONS: (1) the sofa is 0.88 m deep (z 2.10..2.98) instead of z 2.3..3.0; 0.7 m is too shallow for a real sofa. (2) Loungers: the plan gives (-4.6,0,-2.1) and (-5.4,0,-2.1) facing west, but two 1.85 m chaises in line along x would overlap. They are placed side by side instead, at (-4.95, 0, -2.4) and (-4.95, 0, -1.2) facing west, with the low table between them at (-4.5, 0, -1.8). (3) Dining chairs and bar stools are instancedSet groups rather than per-chair furniture. STILL IMPERFECT: (a) KITCHEN ISLAND NOT IN THE CH3 FRAME. Its plan position (2.3, -1.3) is about 75 deg right of the ch3 view axis, and the right frustum edge is only about 31 deg (VIEW_SHIFT film offset). So the island, stools, kitchen pendants and kitchen run are not visible in the chapter 3 screenshot, and that acceptance item fails as written. Sofa, coffee table, armchair, floor lamp, dining set, linear pendant, plant and sheers all read. Fixing it needs a product decision: move the island into view (e.g. toward x -0.3..0.5, z -1.2, which crowds the living zone), or change the fixed ch3 position or target. Neither was done because the plan fixes both. (b) The balcony loungers sit beside and behind the ch4 camera, so they only appear during the ch3 to ch4 move. (c) The balustrade glass is barely visible at ch4 (opacity 0.12 low-iron); the bronze cap rail reads. (d) The nearest downlight bezels at the top edge of the ch3 frame read as dark rings. (e) The media console, art frame and side table are mostly behind the story panel at ch3.
